messages:
matt: Morning — quick async sync for routing/auth/rate-limits. Drop 1) what you did yesterday 2) blockers 3) plan today. Keep it short, thx :v:

anna: Yesterday: landed PR #4822 for header-based routing and ran staging smoke tests. curl check looked good: `curl -H "x-customer: beta" https://staging-api.redwood.dev/route` returned 200 + expected backend. No blockers. Today: schedule canary rollout + update docs and a short migration note for Ops. @dave can you eyeball the docs?

sophia: Yesterday: investigated spike of 429s from Dedicated during a burst test. Found the token refill math in `rate_policy_v2` doesn't account for concurrent refills. Sample log: `[rate-limiter] user=acct-123 tokens=0 burst=5 drop=true 2026-03-16T22:14:03Z`. Blocker: need a small config change + unit test to reproduce.

ravi: I can take that. I'll pair with @sophia later today. Quick ask: @anna do you have a sample replay (pcap or request headers) for the burst pattern? That'll help tune the refill. I'll open an issue and link the trace.

dave: Reviewed #4822 — LGTM overall, left one NIT about adding an integration test for the fallback route. Also updated `scripts/canary.sh` to add the header toggle: ```bash
# flip header routing for canary
./scripts/canary.sh --toggle-header x-customer --percentage 5
``` Small change, I can push if you want.

ci-bot: Deploy to staging succeeded for commit abc123 (pipeline #2147) — health checks OK.

anna: @dave please push the canary script tweak, thanks. I want to start a 5% canary at 10:30 PT.

matt: Plan: @ravi + @sophia fix refill math today, add unit test + small config migration. @anna will run 5% canary after Dave's script update. If canary looks good for 30m, promote. Blockers: none else. Ping me if you hit infra quotas or need extra GPU for replay. :thumbsup:

sophia: filing PR now with test and a changelog entry.

ravi: opening issue #987 with traces and initial hypothesis. Will DM @anna for sample replay.

matt: perfect — moving on. If anyone needs a quick review ping me in thread or react with :eyes:.
